description: Get one order of the rikma by its ref (`<rikmaId>:<externalId>`, as POST /orders answered). Returns the same enriched order as the list, plus the holder and the note the rikma sees. Members only — buyer contact is members-only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getRikmaOrderTool

orderRef.description: The order ref, e.g. "57:pi_3Q8x…" — or an orderId (the tool tries both).
